text:
leah_sales: Need a hosted API key for a financial-services POC. Customer wants 10-day TTL, rotation every 24h, IP allowlist 3.120.45.0/24, and KMS-wrapped secrets (they require us to store key material encrypted with their KMS key). Can we do KMS-wrapping for hosted keys or only for Private?

nikhil_se: Good question. Hosted keys can be stored encrypted at rest in our vault, but binding to a customer-managed KMS key (BYOK) currently exists only for Private deployments. For hosted POCs we can offer server-side encryption + strict access controls, plus short TTL and rotation to meet their security posture. Would that be acceptable?

leah_sales: Customer insists on customer-managed key. They're asking if we can at least wrap the hosted secret with a transient envelope key derived from their provided public key. Any workaround?

jess_infra: We can't plug a customer KMS into our hosted vault today. Workaround options: 1) Use Private trial (VPC) for the POC so they can BYOK — takes ~3-5 business days. 2) Provide hosted key but generate ephemeral key material client-side: we issue a signed token (key-id) and they exchange it with our mutual TLS endpoint to derive the API secret locally. That second option is experimental and needs engineering signoff.

leah_sales: They prefer not to wait. Can we scope down the requirement: accept HOK (holder-of-key) where client presents a client cert on TLS to use the hosted key?

nikhil_se: We support mTLS as an additional authentication layer for some enterprise accounts. For POC we could enable request-level mTLS enforcement for the key if the customer's client supports it. That gives strong assurance without full BYOK. I'll check if 3.120.45.0/24 IP allowlist + mTLS + 24h rotation meets legal.

emma_cs: I'll loop in Acme's security contact (sec@finco.com) to confirm. Also note: if key suspected compromised, fastest path is `rwdctl keys revoke key-4011` then `rwdctl keys create --parent key-4011 --ttl 240h --rotate 24h --ip-allowlist 3.120.45.0/24`. We can publish a mini playbook for them.

tokenbot: provisioning queued. provisional resource key-4011 (masked). Expires in 10 days. Rotation schedule: 24h. Owner: sec@finco.com. :lock:

jess_infra: Action plan: 1) I will provision hosted key under sales-pocs with IP allowlist and 24h rotation. 2) Ask Security to approve mTLS enforcement for this key and add sec@finco.com as approved requester. 3) If customer insists on BYOK, propose Private POC and estimate timeline.

leah_sales: Sounds good. Please post masked vault path and audit link when done. Also need billing tag: acct=finco-poc and cost center fc-42.

jess_infra: Running internal cmd (no secrets in chat):
```
rwdctl keys create --project sales-pocs \ 
  --ttl 240h --rotate 24h \ 
  --ip-allowlist 3.120.45.0/24 \ 
  --tags acct=finco-poc,costcenter=fc-42 \ 
  --owner sec@finco.com
```
I'll enable mTLS enforcement flag pending security approval.

tokenbot: audit: key-4011 created by jess_infra at 1945678967. Tags: acct=finco-poc,costcenter=fc-42. Rotations every 24h. :white_check_mark:

emma_cs: Added calendar reminder to revoke on POC end date 2025-12-01. Leah, I'll draft the playbook and attach to the handoff doc.

leah_sales: Thanks all. Will update the customer: hosted + mTLS + 24h rotate as interim, Private BYOK if they need absolute BYOK.
